⇒ \\(V_{new} = \\left(\\frac{4}{3}\\right) \\pi (0.008r^3)\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(V_{new} = 0.008 \\left(\\frac{4}{3}\\right) \\pi r^3\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(V_{new} = 0.008 V_{initial}\\)

\n\n

ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਮੀ = \\(V_{initial} - V_{new}\\)

\n\n

⇒ ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਮੀ = \\(V_{initial} - 0.008 V_{initial}\\)

\n\n

⇒ ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਮੀ = \\(0.992 V_{initial}\\)

\n\n

ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਮੀ = \\(\\left(\\frac{Decrease \\, in \\, volume}{Initial \\, volume}\\right) × 100\\)

\n\n

⇒ ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਮੀ = \\(\\left(\\frac{0.992 V_{initial}}{V_{initial}}\\right) × 100\\)

\n\n

⇒ ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਮੀ = 0.992 x 100

\n\n

⇒ ਆਇਤਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਮੀ = 99.2%

\n\n

ਗੋਲੇ ਦਾ ਆਇਤਨ 99.2% ਘੱਟ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "All your old letters have been kept"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Letters have been kept by us."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Old letters were kept"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Your old letters were being kept"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
The correct answer is Option 1.
\n\n
 
\n\n
Key Points
\n\n
    \n\t
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
    • \n\t
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "I have kept all your old letters."
    • \n\t
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "all your old letters" at the beginning.
    • \n\t
  • Change the active verb form "have kept" to "have been kept" (present perfect passive).
    • \n\t
  • Omit the original subject "I" as it is not required in the passive voice structure.
    • \n
\n\n
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
\n\n
 
\n\n
Correct Sentence: "All your old letters have been kept."
\n\n
 
\n\n
Additional Information
\n\n
    \n\t
  • Option 2: "Letters have been kept by us." – Incorrect, as it changes the subject-object relationship.
    • \n\t
  • Option 3: "Old letters were kept." – Incorrect, as it uses the past simple tense instead of the present perfect tense.
    • \n\t
  • Option 4: "Your old letters were being kept." – Incorrect, as it uses the past continuous tense instead of the present perfect tense.
    • \n

      • \n\t\t

      \n\t\t
    • The direct speech is converted to indirect speech without quotation marks.
      • \n\t\t
    • The conjunction "that" is used to connect the reporting clause and the reported speech.
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n
\n\n
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
\n\n

Correct Sentence: Sandeep told his friend that he never sleeps during daytime.
